items.headline: Bitcoin DeFi Protocol Hashi Launches on $SUI Mainnet
items.summary: Hashi is live on $SUI mainnet, processing BTC deposits with hBTC usable for Fluid loans and HoneyB vaults on Upshift — a fresh Bitcoin DeFi use case.

items.headline: 1inch Integrates $HYPE Perpetual Futures Into Its dApp
items.summary: 1inch users can now open $HYPE perpetual positions directly, with any held token auto-routed to USDC and deposited on Hyperliquid.

items.headline: Bitwise Files SEC Registration for a $ZEC ETF
items.summary: Bitwise has filed to launch a $ZEC trust giving shareholders direct price exposure to Zcash — another institutional milestone for the privacy coin.

items.headline: $ANT Token Debuts on Solana With $1M Meteora Pool
items.summary: Backpack's Anthropic-linked $ANT token started trading on Solana on IPO day, with a Meteora ANT-USDC pool quickly holding ~$1.06M. US persons excluded.

items.headline: $JTO Sinks 46% in 28 Days, Lagging BTC and ETH
items.summary: Jito's $JTO lost ~21% in a week versus ~12% for BTC, as the Solana MEV protocol's dollar-denominated fees soften. Capitulation or entry point?
